description_en: Queries the coupon usage after a distribution partner issues coupons

kebab_example: aliyun agency list-coupon-usage --account oqevfbveuadcrduzmf@ttirv.net --status AVAILABLE --page 1 --page-size 20 --uid 1133166938931507 --coupon-template-id 5075915 --t2-partner-uid 123456768 --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
